problem_statement.description: What is actually wrong or wanted, as a precise engineering problem.

approach.description: The chosen strategy, plus the main rejected alternative and why.

plan.description: Ordered concrete steps, each independently verifiable. The smallest change that fully solves the problem.

affected_surface.description: Files, modules, interfaces or systems touched. Public contracts called out.

risks.description: What could break, edge cases, compatibility concerns, and mitigations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Objective, testable criteria the reviewer checks one by one, verbatim.

test_strategy.description: What to test and how, grounded in the repository's own setup.

open_questions.description: External facts not resolvable from the repository.

handoff_id.description: The analysis handoff id, or null.
